_comment_overrides: uuid <11.1.1 (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq) reaches us only transitively, via gaxios / google-gax / teeny-request inside firebase-admin. Those callers use uuid.v4() with no buf argument so the advisory is not reachable here, but pinning the whole tree to a patched uuid clears it rather than relying on that staying true. firebase-admin itself is held at v12 on purpose: v13/v14 are breaking majors and this service is not deployed yet, so there is no environment to integration-test an upgrade against.
